Make in India.fact: Make in India is an initiative by the Government of India to create and encourage companies to develop, manufacture and assemble products in India and incentivize dedicated investments into manufacturing.  The policy approach was to create a conducive environment for investments, develop a modern and efficient infrastructure, and open up new sectors for foreign capital.  Make in India has been unsuccessful at achieving its stated targets.  Under this programme, the share of manufacturing in GDP was projected to reach 25% by 2022.
